# Distortion › Warp

**What belongs here.** Smooth non-rigid deformation.

**Examples.** ripple, swirl, displacement, liquify

**Family test.** Do the pixels bend, smear, glitch, pixelate or scatter?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Liquid Warp](liquid-warp/) | The picture ripples and melts like a reflection in water, and the new scene ripples back into focus. |
| [Pixel Stretch](pixel-stretch/) | The new scene sweeps in with its leading edge smeared into long streaks, like pixels stretched by speed. |
